\u27e6CODE3\u27e7: ["```python", "from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext", "from pydantic_ai_harness.filesystem import FileSystem", "from pydantic_ai_harness.shell import Shell", "from pydantic_ai_harness.smol_sandbox import SmolSandbox", "", "agent = Agent('anthropic:claude-opus-5-5', capabilities=[SmolSandbox(image='python:3.12-alpine'), Shell(), FileSystem()])", "", "", "@agent.tool", "async def run_python(ctx: RunContext, code: str) -> str:", "    \"\"\"Run a Python snippet in the VM.\"\"\"", "    result = await ctx.workspace.run(['python', '-c', code], timeout=10)", "    return result.stdout + result.stderr", "```"]
\u27e6CODE4\u27e7: ["```python", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai_harness.coder import Coder", "from pydantic_ai_harness.smol_sandbox import SmolSandbox", "", "agent = Agent('anthropic:claude-opus-5-5', capabilities=[SmolSandbox(image='python:3.12-alpine'), Coder()])", "", "result = agent.run_sync('Write a script that prints the first 10 primes, and run it.')", "ref = result.workspace.ref  # store this, e.g. in your database", "", "later = agent.run_sync('Now make it print the first 100.', workspace=ref)", "```"]
\u27e6CODE5\u27e7: ["```python", "from pydantic_ai.workspaces import WorkspaceRef", "from pydantic_ai_harness.smol_sandbox import SmolSandbox", "", "", "async def stop_vm(ref: WorkspaceRef) -> None:", "    machine = await SmolSandbox().backend(ref).get_sandbox()", "    await machine.stop()", "```"]
\u27e6CODE6\u27e7: ["```python", "import asyncio", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.workspaces import Workspace", "from pydantic_ai_harness.coder import Coder", "from pydantic_ai_harness.smol_sandbox import SmolSandbox, SmolSandboxBackend", "", "agent = Agent('anthropic:claude-opus-5-5', capabilities=[SmolSandbox(), Coder()])", "", "", "async def main() -> None:", "    backend = SmolSandboxBackend(image='python:3.12-alpine', allow_internet_access=True)", "    try:", "        workspace = Workspace(backend)", "        await workspace.write_text('calc.py', 'def add(a, b):\\n    return a - b\\n')", "        install = await workspace.run(['pip', 'install', 'pytest'], timeout=300)", "        if install.exit_code != 0:", "            raise RuntimeError(f'pip install failed: {install.stderr}')", "        result = await agent.run('Fix the bug in calc.py.', workspace=backend)", "        print(result.output)", "    finally:", "        ref = backend.ref  # set once the VM exists", "        if ref is not None:", "            await SmolSandbox().destroy(ref)", "", "", "if __name__ == '__main__':", "    asyncio.run(main())", "```"]
